notes.subject: yra
notes.rationale: Hebrew lacks a copula; the appositional doubling שמים שמים reads 'heavens [are] heavens of YHWH'

notes.subject: jis
notes.rationale: Subject pronoun supplied — Hebrew נתן has no expressed subject; Yah is implied from the first half

notes.subject: השמים שמים
notes.rationale: Doubled noun as intensification, 'the heavens, the very heavens' — the repetition is kept but the appositional force is softened in Lithuanian

notes.subject: dangus
notes.rationale: שמים is a dual, 'the two heavens' — Lithuanian has no dual, the two-ness is lost

translation: Dangus — dangus yra Jahvės, o ⟨את⟩ žemę jis davė žmonių sūnums.
